name: General Varka
title: Flamebound General
bio: Supreme commander of all Emberheart forces. A battle-scarred dragonborn who leads ~3,200 trained troops across infantry, cavalry, wyrmwing flyers, golem forces, and naval guard. Respected for tactical brilliance and unwavering loyalty to the Flamekeeper.
motivation: Maintain military readiness and protect Emberheart from all threats, internal and external.
